performance.verdict: CPL is efficient but Google spend at $0 breaks August prove-it mandate.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — scoreboard integrity is broken without them.
OVERDUE: Renewal closed 2026-07-23 — prove-it month is live but no confirmed Google/LSA spend has appeared; 28-day Google spend is $0.
CPL improved 26% week-over-week to ~$11.90 on 28-day basis; last 3 days (Aug 15–17) averaged 4 leads/day vs 4.3 prior 3 days — efficiency holding, volume flat.
Spend dropped sharply Aug 14–15 ($21, $18.51) — lowest 2-day stretch in 45 days — before partially recovering to $41/$34; budget exhaustion or manual pause likely.
GHL shows 80 opportunities created vs 122 leads (28d), 0 appointments, 0 won — intake leak confirmed: leads arriving but not converting to scheduled appointments in CRM.

suggestions.text: Escalate phone-match attribution gap and sync/contact cleanup as prove-it blockers; complete both before 2026-08-21.
suggestions.monday_update: Two overdue SOW items are breaking the client's scoreboard: phone-match attribution (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14). Without these, leads cannot be traced from ad click to patient chair, which is the exact metric the client is using to decide renewal. Both must be resolved by 2026-08-21. Success check: attribution gap closed with confirmed call-match data flowing, and GHL contacts verified clean — confirmed by Ahmed/Ali and signed off by Nacer.

suggestions.text: Investigate Aug 14–15 spend collapse ($18.51 low); confirm budget cap or manual pause and restore consistent daily pacing at ~$41/day.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend dropped to $21.11 and $18.51 on Aug 14–15, the lowest two-day stretch in 45 days, before partially recovering. CPL is healthy at ~$11.90 so this is a pacing/cap problem, not a performance problem. Confirm whether a budget cap was hit or a manual pause occurred, and restore consistent ~$41/day pacing. Success check: spend stabilizes above $40/day for 3 consecutive days by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake process: 80 opps created, 0 appointments booked in 28 days — confirm Lily/new hire workflow is converting leads to scheduled appointments.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL recorded 80 opportunities created against 122 leads with 0 appointments and 0 won in the 28-day window. This is an intake leak, not an ads problem — leads are arriving but not being scheduled. Coordinate with Lily and the new intake hire to confirm the follow-up workflow is active and that GHL appointment status is being updated correctly. Success check: at least 10 appointments showing in GHL by the 2026-08-25 biweekly Lily sync.
